This compares request paths, not measured latency or cost. Default Event Functions are shown; Managed Instances differ.
Token checks, Secrets Manager, logs, deployment storage and networking are omitted from these comparison lanes.
The ALB is this ECS example's ingress choice. Web Functions currently support Node.js; use the blog for current limits and billing.
